notes.title: Billy Bumbum now available in more languages!
notes.content:
Hey everybody,

You'll now be able to play Billy Bumbum in different languages! You can change the language via the in-game settings.

Supported languages are:

[list]
[*]English
[*]Spanish
[*]Portuguese
[*]Italian
[*]German
[*]Japanese
[*]Korean
[/list]

Enjoy!

tags.feature: You'll now be able to play Billy Bumbum in different languages!

notes.title: Hotfix 002
notes.content:
Just another little hotfix coming your way. The issues tackled:

[list]
[*] Tweaked the following levels to prevent unintended solutions

[list]
[*] Shiri Springs - 17
[*] Zadek Complex - 19
[*] Zadek Complex - 22
[/list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the ‘Lost & Found’ achievement wouldn’t trigger. If you’ve previously met the requirements for this achievement but didn’t get the achievement due to this bug, simply go to the ‘Friends Screen’ and the achievement should unlock for you.

[*] Additional minor bug fixes
[/list]

Cheers,
Jonathan

notes.title: Hotfix 001
notes.content:
Billy’s very first hotfix, how exciting! 

The issue tackled:

[list]
[*][b]World map loading times have been greatly reduced! [/b]Yay!
[/list]
Thank you all for reporting this issue. Enjoy MORE freedom farts in LESS time!

Cheers,
Jonathan
